image_description: A medium shot of a male musician playing an electric guitar while seated on a stool on a stage. He is wearing a dark jacket, tie, and jeans. To his right, another musician is partially visible. The background is a plain light blue curtain or backdrop. Stage equipment including microphone stands and monitors are visible. The lighting appears artificial, typical of a performance setting.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The fingers on the fretboard appear slightly fused and lack distinct separation; the grip looks anatomically ambiguous rather than precise.
The legs of the stool merge into the shadows and the stage floor without clear contact points or distinct geometry, appearing somewhat melted.
The base of the mic stand seems to float slightly or lacks a firm grounding shadow, making its position on the stage plane ambiguous.
